problems.title: Automated Water Tank Monitoring
problems.description: We run three 10,000-liter overhead industrial water storage tanks feeding continuous dying machinery. Operators currently climb rusted ladders twice every shift with dipsticks to check water levels. When tanks run dry mid-batch, expensive dyeing runs get contaminated and electric pump motors burn out running dry.
problems.painPoint: Manual dipstick readings are hazardous, inaccurate, and late. Frequent pump dry-runs cause motor burning and costly textile production line stoppage.
deliverables: ESP32 microcontroller circuit with ultrasonic level sensor (JSN-SR04T waterproof)
Automated relay cut-off switch triggered when water falls below 15% or overflows 95%
Local LED bar indicator panel + 4G/WiFi telemetry ping every 5 minutes
Circuit diagram, bill of materials (under ₹2,800 per tank), and Arduino source code
problems.hardwareProvided: Access to test tank on-site, 24V DC power rails, and reimbursement for test sensors.

problems.title: Patient Queue & Token Display
problems.description: Our outpatient department handles over 400 rural patients daily across 6 specialist consulting rooms. Crowding at reception causes chaotic waiting halls and patients missing their appointments. We need a lightweight, responsive token queue management web application accessible from tablet browsers and smart TVs.
problems.painPoint: Patients stand in disorganised queues for hours, doctors experience unpredictable arrival flows, and reception staff spend 70% of their time shouting token numbers manually.
deliverables: Reception counter module for fast token generation & doctor assignment (thermal printer integration)
Doctor consulting room dashboard to call next patient, mark delayed, or transfer patient
Big-screen waiting room TV display view showing current running token numbers with bilingual voice announcement (Tamil & English)
WhatsApp/SMS token status link for patient live progress tracking
problems.mentorTitle: Medical Director & Chief of Clinical Operations

problems.title: Soil Moisture Irrigation Advisory
problems.description: Over 85 member farmers cultivate moisture-sensitive tapioca and turmeric on red loamy soil. Electricity supply to irrigation pumps is irregular (often provided during night hours). Over-irrigation causes tuber rot while under-irrigation stunts yields by 30%. We need a field sensor unit and bilingual mobile advisory tool.
problems.painPoint: Farmers irrigate blindly whenever electricity switches on, depleting borewell aquifers and causing root fungal rot. Lack of localized soil moisture guidance wastes water and reduces crop yield.
deliverables: Capacitive soil moisture & temperature probe interfacing with low-power solar microcontroller
Python agronomic recommendation engine factoring soil moisture thresholds and local 3-day weather forecast
Simple React Native mobile app with regional Tamil voice/audio prompts and color-coded irrigation recommendations ("Irrigate 45 mins", "Do not irrigate today")
Low-power sleep state firmware ensuring 6-month battery operation
problems.hardwareProvided: 5 farmer test plots available with drip irrigation access and solar cell frames.

problems.title: Cold Storage Temperature Logger & SMS Alert
problems.description: Our bulk milk chilling centers hold 15,000 liters of fresh milk before refrigerated transport tankers arrive. If compressor power trips or refrigerant leaks overnight, milk spoils within 3 hours. We require real-time temperature loggers with cellular SMS alerts to the duty manager whenever temperature exceeds 4°C.
problems.painPoint: Unnoticed chiller tripping results in spoiled milk batches costing over ₹3,00,000 per incident and disputes with cooperative dairy farmers.
deliverables: Industrial PT100 temperature probe node with GSM SIM800 module for backup SMS alerts
Local dashboard showing 48-hour cooling curve and power supply telemetry
Cloud MQTT bridge for multi-center aggregate supervision
Fail-safe audible siren buzzer trigger at Chilling Center site

problems.title: Textile Loom Yarn Breakage Optical Detector
problems.description: During automated shuttleless powerloom weaving, a single snapped yarn thread that goes unnoticed for 2 minutes ruins meters of fabric cloth with visible horizontal streak defects. We want an edge camera module positioned above the warp sheet to detect thread breaks in real time and trigger instant loom stoppage.
problems.painPoint: Manual visual inspection across 24 running looms is impossible for 2 operators. Fabric defect scrap rates are at 4.2%, causing significant profit erosion.
deliverables: High-speed camera setup and lightweight optical flow / edge detection script running on Raspberry Pi 5
Relay trigger to loom emergency stop brake within 300ms of yarn snap
Fault log with timestamp and image snapshot for machine tuning
Rugged dust-proof enclosure design recommendation for high-lint textile mill environments

problems.title: Municipal Solid Waste Route Optimizer
problems.organization: Trichy City Sanitation & Resource Recovery Cell
problems.description: Our sanitation department operates 38 compactor trucks and 110 battery-operated vehicles across 65 wards. Routes are currently planned on static driver memory, leading to fuel wastage, missed commercial garbage bins, and traffic jams in temple bazaar lanes during peak hours.
problems.painPoint: Suboptimal collection routes burn 22% excess diesel fuel daily and create citizen complaints about missed community bins.
deliverables: Interactive GIS map planner showing bins with capacity flags and road one-way constraints
Vehicle routing heuristic engine optimizing truck paths based on real-time bin priority
Driver mobile turn-by-turn waypoint interface in regional language
Daily fuel savings and ward clearance efficiency dashboard

problems.title: Offline-First Primary Health Center Vaccine Tracker
problems.description: Village Health Nurses (VHNs) in hilly tribal hamlets have zero cellular reception while conducting immunization camps. When they return to the block headquarters, manual paper registers have to be typed into national portals, causing 2-week recording backlogs and missed second-dose infant tracking.
problems.painPoint: Paper immunization records get damaged in field transit and offline field data entry is lost, jeopardizing infant vaccination schedules.
deliverables: Progressive Web App with 100% offline functionality using IndexedDB caching
Zero-conflict automatic sync when tablet reconnects to cellular/WiFi network
Child immunization reminder schedule calculation with Tamil audio guidance for mothers
Exportable CSV and Government portal compliant JSON format

problems.title: Solar Rooftop Net-Metering Inverter Gateway
problems.description: 30 small manufacturing workshops have installed 20kW–50kW rooftop solar plants with different inverter brands (Delta, SMA, Sungrow). Each proprietary app is locked, preventing aggregated power export tracking and TANGEDCO net-metering settlement audits. We need a unified RS485 Modbus logger.
problems.painPoint: MSME owners cannot verify whether electricity exported to the grid matches utility credit statements, losing thousands of rupees in unverified billing.
deliverables: Universal RS485 to ESP32 gateway querying standard SunSpec Modbus registers
Unified cloud dashboard displaying real-time power generation, factory self-consumption, and grid export
Discrepancy audit tool comparing inverter energy meters against EB billing meters
Open-source hardware schematics using low-cost isolated RS485 transceiver

proposals.builderRole: Final Year ECE & Embedded Systems Builder
proposals.solutionSummary: We will build a weatherproof dual-sensor probe using JSN-SR04T ultrasonic module paired with a backup float switch for hardware failsafe. Telemetry sent via ESP32 over WiFi/4G to an MQTT broker, with an integrated optocoupler relay controlling pump contactors directly.

Excellent. Can you and your team visit the plant next Tuesday to measure the tank flange dimensions and inspect the 24V DC control cabinet?
Good day! Is the token queue system able to run on our existing Android smart TVs without requiring extra mini-PCs?
Yes Doctor, the waiting room display is built with React as a lightweight web app that opens directly in Android TV Chrome/Silk browser in kiosk mode.
